title: bolbitis × terminans
intro: Bolbitis × terminans, commonly known as the Bolbitis fern, is a hybrid plant species resulting from the cross between Bolbitis heudelotii and Bolbitis heterophylla. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Bolbitis × terminans include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in Bolbitis × terminans have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
